purpose: Surface container that groups related content with optional header, title, description, and footer regions.
useWhen: Grouping a self-contained unit of content such as a summary, preview, or settings panel.
Composing a list of comparable items where each needs its own framed region.

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering a bare visual surface without slotted regions — use surface instead.
Presenting a single key metric — use statistic or statistic-group instead.
